# Cases for canonical_probe.cpp. Run `canonical_probe record` to regenerate expected.txt;
# see README.md. Fields are separated by one tab.
dir Mixed\Case
file Mixed\Case\file.txt
dir Straße
dir {deep}
file {deep}\file.txt
junction link Mixed
#
# Drive-letter paths. C:\Windows exists on every supported host, so these results are
# literal rather than relative to the scratch root.
canonical	C:\Windows
canonical	c:\windows\system32\..\SYSTEM32\.\drivers\
canonical	C:/Windows/System32
canonical	\\?\C:\Windows
canonical	\\?\c:\windows\
canonical	C:\
canonical	c:\
weakly	C:\Windows\cao-winfs-missing\child\
weakly	c:/windows/./cao-winfs-missing/../System32/
weakly	\\?\C:\Windows\cao-winfs-missing
#
# On-disk case and non-ASCII names.
canonical	{root}\MIXED\case\FILE.TXT
canonical	{root}\STRAßE
weakly	{root}\straße\missing
#
# Dot segments and trailing separators.
canonical	{root}\Mixed\.\Case\..\Case\file.txt
canonical	{root}\Mixed\Case\
canonical	{root}\Mixed\Case\\
canonical	{root}/Mixed//Case/./
canonical	{root}\Mixed\Case\file.txt\
weakly	{root}\Mixed\Case\
weakly	{root}\Mixed\missing\
weakly	{root}\Mixed\missing\.
weakly	{root}\Mixed\missing\..
weakly	{root}\Mixed\missing\..\
weakly	{root}\Mixed\.\missing\x\..\y\
weakly	{root}\Mixed\Case\..\..\missing
weakly	{root}/Mixed//missing//child
weakly	{root}\Mixed\Case\file.txt\
weakly	{root}\Mixed\Case\file.txt\child
#
# Missing paths.
canonical	{root}\missing
canonical	{root}\missing\child
canonical	{root}\Mixed\Case\file.txt\child
#
# Junctions are followed.
canonical	{root}\link\Case\file.txt
weakly	{root}\link\Case\missing\
#
# Long paths: every input and result through {deep} is longer than MAX_PATH.
canonical	{root}\{deep}
canonical	{root}\{deep}\file.txt
canonical	\\?\{root}\{deep}\file.txt
canonical	{root}\{deep}\..\..\..\..\..\..\{deep}\file.txt
canonical	{root}\{deep}\
canonical	{root}\{deep}\missing
weakly	{root}\{deep}\missing\child\
weakly	{root}\{deep}\.\missing\..\file.txt
weakly	{root}\{deep}\missing\..\..\new
